summary: Berto Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO and concurrent private placement on May 18, 2026. The IPO consisted of 31,510,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $315.1M in gross proceeds. Each unit includes one ordinary share and one-third of one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Simultaneously, the sponsor purchased 3,500,000 private placement warrants for $3.5M. Net proceeds of $315.1M were placed in a trust account. The filing also provides the audited balance sheet. This is a routine SPAC IPO closing report, not triggering a special situation category.
